verdict.rationale: Whether a product's source is readable under an open license is a fair question for a banking API service, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows a client SDK repository on GitHub (sdk-python) and an OpenAPI spec. Those are client libraries and an interface description, not the product's own source, and no open license is mentioned anywhere in the pack.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
